card.title: Newton's third law
card.body: $\vec{F}_{AB} = -\vec{F}_{BA}$ — whenever object A pushes or pulls object B, object B simultaneously pushes or pulls A with **equal magnitude** and **opposite direction**.
card.says: forces always come in **action–reaction pairs** acting on **two different objects**, so they never cancel each other on one body's force diagram.
card.from: Isaac Newton's *Principia* (1687): every force is a two-way interaction between a pair of bodies, never a one-sided push.
card.useWhen: two objects touch, collide, pull each other via a rope, or attract via gravity, and you need the force on one from the force on the other.
card.example: A $50\text{ kg}$ skater pushes a wall backward with $60\text{ N}$ → the wall pushes the skater forward with $60\text{ N}$, giving $a = \dfrac{60}{50} = 1.2\text{ m/s}^2$ on frictionless ice.
card.analogy: Swimming forward by pushing water backward: your hand pushes the water, and the water pushes you forward just as hard.
